load_cifar10_dataset: load the CIFAR-10 dataset as a tf.data.Dataset with configurable batch sizes and train or test split
load_extra_npz_dataset: load extra training data from an NPZ file path and return a tf.data.Dataset with batching
load_dummy_data: load fictive dummy data for testing purposes and return a tf.data.Dataset with zero-filled images
cifar10_normalize: normalize a CIFAR-10 image array using the standard CIFAR-10 mean and standard deviation values
cifar10_preprocess: create a preprocessing function for CIFAR-10 images with random jitter and flip for training mode
